case_number: 2023 INSC 683; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 2340 OF 2023 (Arising out of S.L.P. (Criminal) No. 10656 of 2022)
summary: FIR quashing challenge; dacoity allegation under IPC s.395 unsustainable without specific date/time; inordinate delay (2021 incident reported Sept 2022); absence of medical evidence for assault claims; land dispute context; false implication allegations; reliance on Bhajan Lal guidelines; quashing refused at HC due to cognizable offense appearance.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.395, s.504, s.506, s.323
final_judgment: Appeal allowed with directions to trial court to complete proceedings within six months; anticipatory bail protection maintained pending trial.
